start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:hand-to-an-agent with the job: turn my voice note from this morning into an outline with a hook and three points." It hands that job, with every detail of what arrived, to one of your AIs; the AI that takes it does the job and what it did is kept as the result. Your account's starting rules also start it for you whenever a message arrives.
no_lists_because: The item reads and writes no list: its one step hands the job to an AI, and the job and its result are kept on the run itself.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what you want done with what arrived, in plain words (the job), and name the AI if one should take it (to_agent); leave it out for whichever of your AIs takes it first.
2. The AI starts workflow:hand-to-an-agent with that job; its one step, handle, waits for an AI to take the job.
3. Read the run: its handle step holds what the AI that took it did. A message that arrives starts the same workflow by itself through the starting rule starting:arrivals.

worked_examples.title: A voice note becomes an outline
worked_examples.ask: Hand my voice note from this morning to my AI: turn it into an outline with a hook and three points.

input.job: Turn this voice note into an outline with a hook and three points
input.said: Outline from this morning's voice note

worked_examples.given: The job in plain words and what arrived (the voice note's id and words).
worked_examples.hands_back: Step handle answers with what the AI that took the job did: here, the outline with its hook and three points.
